title: Proposed additive text event output fields
description: OUTPUT ONLY. Validates proposed additions on an upgraded event response while allowing all existing event fields. It is not a write schema and does not authorize field visibility or approve lifecycle/counting policy.

scheduled.description: Stored selected interval, or null when no interval exists. Server checks ordering and canonical UTC serialization; this is not an external calendar-event identifier.

closed.description: Derived from presence of a stored selected interval under the proposed read contract, separately from existing is_archived. The schema alone does not approve closed-event mutation or reopening policy.

display_timezone.description: Presentation-only validated IANA zone or null when unspecified; null is not an alias for UTC. The server validates the identifier and does not derive it from a numeric user offset.

owner_participates.description: Whether the owner participates as an attendee/respondent. This does not itself choose whether follow-up counts include the owner; pending_population must state the approved rule.

response_totals.description: Owner-authorized counts with explicit population definitions. Nonowner or otherwise hidden totals are null, never fabricated zeros. Categories are not automatically disjoint or additive; owner counting rules remain subject to approval.

populationLabel.description: Explicit population definition, including owner inclusion/exclusion where relevant; not inferred from the count.
